label: PF Backlog 572
title: Review & communication standard: expand every term/abbreviation IN CONTEXT + decision-ready Gate format (why/what/how, detailed acceptance criteria, recommendation, mitigated-vs-open risks)
body: Iterated sessions lose context: bare codes (A2/A6/B1/AC6/G1..G10, 'locked baseline', 'fail-closed', 'HMAC') are referenced without meaning, forcing the operator to ask what they are. Requirement: in EVERY discussion/review/Gate/report, on FIRST mention expand each term/code/abbreviation with a plain-language description in the same sentence, and keep a small glossary when several appear. Also adopt the decision-ready review format so the operator can decide: (1) Why (value), (2) What changes, (3) How, (4) Acceptance criteria in detail with what proves each, (5) Scope, (6) 360 reconciliation, (7) Impact review + risks that clearly split MITIGATED vs OPEN (needing explicit operator sign-off), (8) Technical details (files/tests), (9) a Recommendation banner (APPROVE / APPROVE WITH ATTENTION / NEEDS REVIEW) and the exact decisions requested.

objective: Make reviews/gates self-explanatory and decision-ready: no unexplained codes; every approval states plainly whether it is OK to approve or needs attention, what is mitigated, and what remains open for explicit operator acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md + workergrid/instructions.md + the /wg command doc state the expanded-in-context rule
the docs define the decision-ready Gate/360 format (why/what/how, detailed AC, recommendation, mitigated vs open risks)
the installed /wg command copy is regenerated byte-identically (sync_global_commands)
a review produced after this change expands all codes on first use (demonstrated)
out_of_scope: the review content itself (only its FORMAT/CLARITY)
approach: Add a binding 'Explain in context' rule + the decision-ready review template to AGENTS.md and the worker charter; mirror the rule in the /wg command doc; regenerate the global command copy with scripts/dev/sync_global_commands.py.
verification: Objective achieved: Review & communication standard: expand every term/abbreviation IN CONTEXT + decision-ready Gate format (why/what/how, detailed acceptance criteria, recommendation, mitigated-vs-open risks)
risks: over-brevity creeping back -> enforced by the charter text + this example
installed copy drift -> sync_global_commands + its check
